title: [AINews] It's Swapping Season
author: swyx .ai
description: November 4, 2026 — OpenAI’s Linux kernel security work, Kimi K3.1 Pro’s open weights, and Ricursive’s Ripple-65B.
summary: As much as there are headlines about changing sides all over the timeline today, there have been major moves in AI as well: Cat Wu leaving Anthropic /Claude Code team where she was Head of Product since inception ( our podcast here ) and is joining OpenAI to lead Core Products PM ( post ). Sharon Zhou ( CEO of Lamini, acquired by AMD last year to be Lisa Su’s VP of AI) is leaving AMD for Anthropic ( post ).
takeaways: Ricursive claims it is the best US open-weight model on agentic coding, ahead of larger MoEs including Muse Spark Open-816B, Beam-501B, Inkling-975B and Nemotron 3 Ultra-550B ( launch ).
He says the model found about 1,000 in one week using about $1M of tokens, and that OpenAI is now putting "a significant amount" of frontier compute toward pro bono open-source patching ( post ).
Modal describes it as a post-training update to K3, with expanded RL for coding, financial research and long-horizon agentic work.
